# Oxmarsh Fen Wildlife Trust - reserve workspace

Working area for the reserve team.

- duties/  the post accountable for each reserve duty

Each reserve duty sits with one post and the list is edited in place, so a duty is never shared between two posts. Entries are kept in the order the duties were added to the reserve work plan. Last reviewed 2026-08-04, reference OF-6641.
